fieldNotes.truckGate: Single fenced truck entrance off N Broadway at NE corner; chain-link gate panel in barbed-wire perimeter fence, posted rules/sign-in board, no barrier arm but a sliding gate in the line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure beside the entrance lane in any Street View frame (Apr 2026 panos); only signage. Hence remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated and fully fenced but unstaffed at the gate = remote/self check-in via posted instructions / call.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Long south-facing dock bank with trailers backed in on both sides of a center extension; ~32 doors estimated from z20 imagery, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer drop lot on the south apron, ~9-row of drop trailers plus XTRA lease trailers along the fence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Greensburg, residential/farm fabric to the south and east, open fields north/west - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard inside the fence between gate and docks easily holds a queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear to run from one continuous south-face cluster; no clearly separate second dock bank confirmed.
